review_response_tasks.stem: Louis wants to notice how his own spoken sentences differ from a model. He would like to keep several attempts and listen to them again, without calling another learner.
options: A

PocketTalk lets you record your voice after hearing a short model sentence. You can play your recording beside the model and try again. The recordings stay in your own folder. There are no live partner calls, books or checks on typed paragraphs.
B

BookNest offers short stories in several levels. You can bookmark a page and tap an unfamiliar word for a meaning. It is for quiet reading: it has no model recordings and does not mark mistakes in your own messages.
C

MessageMender looks at short messages you type. It points out possible word-order and spelling problems and gives an explanation beside each one. You can compare your first draft with your changes. It does not teach through recorded speech or storybooks.
D

SoundRoutes contains recorded conversations from different public places. Hear each conversation, then open its written script. You can pause and replay it. There is no microphone button, so you cannot record yourself, and it does not check typed messages.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A录自己的声音、与范句并听且保留多次。B无录音；C只改键入消息；D虽有对话音频却明确不能录自己。
